caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with curved legs and a gently arched backrest, positioned in a three-quarter side view. The chair is brown with ornate gold decorative patterns on the top rail, the middle of the backrest, and the lower side stretchers. The seat appears to be lighter in color, possibly tan or light brown, and is slightly indented in the center. On the top rail of the chair’s back, there is a small shield-shaped emblem containing red and white vertical stripes capped with a blue upper band, bordered by gold filigree. Above the main image of the chair, there is a detail view of this same decorative top rail and shield, shown horizontally to highlight the ornamentation and colors. The background is plain and neutral, and the drawing is enclosed within a faint rectangular border.
title: Rush Bottom Chair
